verdict.rationale: Alloy is an API-first decisioning service. Its Events and Evaluation APIs can be called programmatically with no UI, and its scheduled Portfolio workflows run automatically. Together these give genuine headless automation, but nothing documents CI usage, a CLI, or a pipeline integration. Missing for 10: a documented CLI or headless runner, CI/CD pipeline integration guidance or examples, a sandbox or test-mode setup for automated runs, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Alloy's Events API allows you to build a real-time integration for decisioning on suspicious ongoing behavior as soon as it happens.
Alloy will return results of the Source Workflow under the evaluations[] array in the Events response.
Workflows can run in real time as part of a Journey evaluating an incoming application, or on a schedule as a Portfolio workflow
Alloy provides a /healthcheck endpoint that confirms basic API connectivity.
